## 📝 rss-ai-draft — START HERE

Watches an RSS feed; when something new appears, Claude drafts an original blog post and drops it in a **review** sheet. It NEVER publishes — a human approves first.

```
Watch RSS Feed → Dedupe New Items → Draft Post (Claude) → Parse Draft → Save Draft (Review Only)
```

### Buyer setup checklist
- [ ] **Watch RSS Feed** → set your `feedUrl` and poll schedule
- [ ] **Draft Post (Claude)** → add Anthropic key (Header Auth `x-api-key`); edit the system prompt / voice
- [ ] **Save Draft (Review Only)** → pick Google account + Sheet + tab (`Drafts for Review`)
- [ ] Activate. Review rows where Status = `NEEDS REVIEW`, then publish by hand.

All credentials are placeholders — nothing runs until you connect your own.

## 🛑 Review-only by design — DO NOT auto-publish

Safety is the product. Every draft lands as **Status = NEEDS REVIEW** and stops there. There is intentionally **no** WordPress / publish node.

Do **not** wire this straight into a publish step. AI drafts can be wrong, off-brand, or legally risky. Always keep a human approval between this sheet and your live site.

When a draft is approved, copy it out (or build a SEPARATE, manually-triggered publish flow that only runs on rows you set to `APPROVED`).

## Dedupe — how it works & limits

Two layers:
1. The **RSS trigger** only emits items newer than the last poll.
2. **Dedupe New Items** remembers every item's `guid`/`link` in workflow static data (last 1000) and drops anything seen before — surviving restarts and overlapping polls.

**Limits:** if a feed omits guids and rewrites links, or republishes with a new id, a duplicate can slip through. Clearing execution data / static data resets memory. One workflow tracks one running list.

## 🔑 LLM key + voice

**Add your key:** Credentials → New → **Header Auth** → Name = `x-api-key`, Value = your Anthropic key. Select it on *Draft Post (Claude)*.

**Edit the voice:** change the `system` prompt inside *Draft Post (Claude)*'s JSON body — that's where tone, length, and angle live.

**OpenAI instead?** URL → `https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions`, Header Auth Name `Authorization` / Value `Bearer sk-...`, swap body to OpenAI shape (BUILD_NOTES).

Default model: `claude-sonnet-4-6`.
